Chapters guide

Chapter 3: Tits Ass Drug Money — GTA 6 progression guide

Jason and Lucia arrive in Vice City and plug into its criminal economy, working for Dre'Quan, Boobie and Raul while assembling the crew, gear and knowledge for the Cartel Heist that closes the chapter. This is where the game's money systems — jewelry jobs, bank jobs, supercar exports — all switch on.

Missions — what sources report

Dexerto's verified list counts 26 mandatory missions (KeenGamer and GameRant agree; GameRant notes one further optional). FinalBoss numbers 31 Chapter 3 entries because it counts money-transfer sub-tasks such as 'Send Money to Lorena' as full missions. KeenGamer also lists the Zorrusso job under two names — 'Steal the Zorrusso for Randy' and 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'.

What unlocks

  • Pay 'n' Spray starts buying cars with a standard tracker (typically ~$2,500+, up to $4,000+ for a good car in perfect condition) and registering them
  • Key Cloner phone app (mission: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, after Crosstown Traffic)
  • Randy's Wish List of high-end cars (22 in total on the reconciled count: 20 on the initial board plus the '64 Mamba GT added by ¡Dale Mamba! and the Truffade Thrax finale; PowerPyx tracks 16 core targets for the Supply & Demand trophy, KeenGamer counts 18, gta.guide says 'about twenty')
  • Snap Gun lockpick tool (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — most guides say he hands it over after your first delivered piece)
  • Dye Pack Jammer (mission: Credit Check)
  • Small bank and payday loan robberies (after Credit Check)
  • Jewelry store robberies (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs)
  • Yasmani as a fence paying premium rates for marked bills and jewelry
  • Storage facilities for stash bags
  • Shore Court Garage (Vintage Vice City Pack) and GTA+ Crosstown Garage, both Chapter 3 per Mobalytics

Free grabs this act

  • $120,000 automatic story payout at the end of the chapter (PowerPyx, via GameMapa and NerdSnack)
  • Vanessa's pink Pfister Growler plus the Del Rio Boulevard Garage it sits in — garage keypad code 92665, from Boobie's laptop in Chapter 3
  • '55 Vapid Stanier (Ultimate Edition, Chapter 3 per KeenGamer)

Warnings & traps

  • Race Against Yago is an hourglass, time-sensitive optional mission — do it the moment its marker appears or it can be missed
  • An advanced tracker reports your position to police whenever you drive slowly or stop; keep your speed up until you near the drop-off, where the signal drops
  • Guides disagree on advanced-tracker cars: gta.guide says they can only be sold and registered at Pay 'n' Spray after delivering the '64 Declasse Mamba GT in '¡Dale Mamba!', while others present Randy as the only outlet — do not assume you can keep one
  • Marked bills cannot be spent; they must go to a fence, and the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check is what lets you take them without the packs bursting
  • Snap Gun timing is disputed in wording: ShowGamer, ScreenRant and Sportskeeda say Yasmani rewards it after the first jewelry delivery, while some guides describe it as the reward for the Jewelry Jobs chain as a whole

Sources & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Walkthrough: All Chapters and Story Missions in Order — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Source: Key cloner in GTA 6: how to get and Randy's list — gta.guide.

Source: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter — GameMapa (built mainly on PowerPyx) (2026-11-18).

Source: How to Get the Snap Gun in GTA 6 — Lockpicking and Stealth Robbery Guide — ShowGamer.

Source: GTA 6 Mission List — All Chapters and Missions — Dexerto.

The Chapter 3 unlock cluster is the best-corroborated in the game — Key Cloner mission, Randy's list and the Credit Check unlocks agree across Polygon, KeenGamer, gta.guide and PowerPyx-derived money guides. Wish-list size is reconciled at 22 with the 16/18 subset counts recorded; the Snap Gun's exact hand-over point remains disputed in wording (first delivery vs the chain as a whole).
